rss: Paramount takes over Warner Bros in $110bn Hollywood merger
title: Two Movie Studios Become One
story: MOVI Studios and CINEMA Stars have joined together to make even more super cool movies! They hope this will help them make new and exciting films for everyone to watch.
storyBig: MOVI Studios has completed a merger with CINEMA Stars, creating a powerhouse in the entertainment industry. This merger is expected to enhance their competitive edge and leverage synergies to produce innovative content.
think: What could happen when two big companies join forces?
bull: More awesome movies could be made!

rss: Last call for the mall? How shopping centres are reinventing themselves
title: Malls Are Trying New Things
story: Malls are finding fun ways to stay popular, like adding game zones and food adventures. They're making sure that going to the mall is more than just shopping.
storyBig: Shopping centers are reinventing themselves by introducing entertainment options such as virtual reality experiences and food courts to attract more visitors. This strategy aims to combat the challenges posed by online shopping trends.
think: Why might people choose to shop online instead of going to a mall?
bull: You can play games while shopping!
bear: Some stores might still close down.
